ciphertext_source: 13 Aug: ciphers/brederode-heidelberg-1621/ciphertext.tsv (scan 379, HEID-1621, two blind Sonnet readers + reconciliation, all M); witness scan 375 (heid1621g/ciphertext_6021_375.tsv, HEID-1621G): numerals 96/96 equal, unit agreement 37/45 = 0.822 (gate 0.90, FAIL, letter naming only). 17 Sept: heid1621g/ciphertext_6021_423.tsv (HEID-1621G, 15 Oct 2026, two blind readers + reconciliation, all M). Nationaal Archief service.archief.nl IIIF.
alphabet: units (pooled N=59: 45 + 14) = a numeral run closed by one letter: 13 Aug mostly pairs (n, n+1) + letter (P), 17 Sept mostly a single number + letter (S1: 12 of 14; one 3-numeral run 61.3.23.x, one bare 119). LETTER FIELD UNRELIABLE: the 375-vs-379 known-answer control fails on the trailing letter only (0.822 < 0.90, re-run after HEID-1621H's look-alike pass unchanged: 22 letter splits, none settled without a re-read of the crops); use the numeral field as the unit key and treat the letter as M until the owner's sign sorter (heid1621h/focus.tsv) or a crop re-read settles it.
constraints: 13 Aug: pairs are (n, n+1) in 40 of 41 (0.976; order-shuffle control p99 0.053; PREREG-HEID1621)
one letter closes each unit; letter naming unreliable (control FAIL above): split pairs r/x, S/B/g, c/x/r, f/s/j, e/w, q/9 (heid1621h/confusion.tsv)
about one unit per Dutch word by line density (S4 lead, M)

two letters, one key (assumption of the pooling, M): the 17 Sept single number vs the 13 Aug pairs -- hypothesis 'single = first number' counted against nulls (HEID-1621H 3b): number-only first 6/12 (value null mean 3.35, p 0.089: not significant), either number 10/12 (p 0.013: not under 0.01); with the letter, first 6/12 and either 9/12 vs the shuffled-pairing null (means 1.09 and 2.25, p 0.0002 and < 0.0001) -- a counted lead (M) that a number shared by both letters carries the same letter sign; never a key
Dutch, 1621, diplomatic letters; the clear prose around both blocks is the letters' own text
recipient-side edition: Resolutien SG NR 5 p.260 res. 1644b, note c 'S.G 6021 (orig.). Gedeeltelijk in code.' -- no decipherment printed
